messages:
Priya Patel: Quick org update — we're splitting the Talent Programs scope that used to live in Platform into two focused leads: Platform Talent (hiring+growth for API/Console) and Runtime Talent (serving/runtime + infra roles). Marcus Lee will step in as Senior Manager, Runtime Talent starting next Monday.
Marcus Lee: excited to take this on — thanks @Priya. I'll be syncing with Eng leads this week to map critical open roles and timelines. happy to be pinged for referrals or prioritization.
Hannah Park: congrats @Marcus! we'll set up a 30m sync to go over a shortlist for the runtime hiring queue.
Samir Khan: big thumbs up. this patching of focus should help ramping throughput for runtime hires. Marcus — can you own the priority order for the next 3 months?
Marcus Lee: yes — priority order will be: 1) Senior Site Reliability Engineer (runtime), 2) Backend Engineer (KV cache), 3) Inference Runtime Engineer (quant/ops). I'll put a tracker in the hiring board by EOD.
Clara Wu: noted. i'll start drafting updated job descriptions and reach out to the top pipeline candidates. Marcus — do you have preferred non-negotiables for the SRE role (oncall experience, cloud infra)?
Marcus Lee: prefer candidates with 3+ years on distributed GPU infra or high-throughput systems, oncall experience required, some exposure to model-serving patterns a plus.
Priya Patel: recruiting and managers — please update the org chart snippet in Confluence. we'll treat any backfill reqs for Platform Talent as separate postings.
HR-Bot: New hire/band assignment checklist: https://redwood.example.com/hr/checklists — auto-created task for Marcus: "Update hiring priorities" due in 3 days.
Hannah Park: quick ask — can we get a weekly 15m stand with hiring ops to unblock any candidate bottlenecks?
Marcus Lee: yes, will schedule recurring 15m starting next Tue 10am PT.
Samir Khan: thanks — this should speed things up. :tada:
